notes.title: Update Notes for Sep 12th
notes.notes:
New Additions:


"Compendium" menu option has been added for owners of Tivick'ing! Chronicles -Another Story-. This can be accessed in the title menu of Tivick'ing! Chronicles after unlocking the \[World Savior] achievement

"Brant's Adventure" sidestory has been added for owners of Tivick'ing! Chronicles -Another Story-, available after unlocking the \[Tale of Brant] achievement


※Base game required to access Tivick'ing! Chronicles -Another Story- content

notes.title: Soundtrack Release Celebration Sale
notes.notes:
Enjoying the soundtrack to Tivick'ing! Chronicles? On Friday, March 24th the Tivick'ing! Chronicles Soundtrack will be available to purchase.

To celebrate the release of the Tivick'ing! Chronicles Soundtrack, the base game will be on sale for one week following the soundtrack release date, until Friday, March 31 at 10 AM PST (1 PM EST).

[previewyoutube=czX0EVQp_LM;full][/previewyoutube]

The soundtrack features 32 original tracks composed by Anna N. (AnnaLalaDreams), and is a total of 51 minutes long. It includes a bonus disc with 4 additional tracks, unused in the base game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43020173/4eafdc86c3ce04a9aa7b177c83c69c282a751596.png

Additionally, the Tivick'ing! Chronicles Game & Soundtrack Bundle will be available shortly after the release of the soundtrack. This bundle includes both the Tivick'ing! Chronicles base game and the Tivick'ing! Chronicles Soundtrack with a bundle discount of 10%!

notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 18
notes.notes:
Text Changes:

Corrected some errors in various character dialogue


Sprite Changes:

The faeries sprite in Crystal Caverns no longer erroneously changes colour when interacted with
Corrected a sprite visibility issue in the scene that plays after entering the destroyed town of Ford for the first time, if entering from the South entrance
Corrected a sprite visibility issue in the scene that plays after exiting Mayor Maple's house
Corrected a sprite visibility issue in the scene that plays after [spoiler]examining the reports in the Secret Room in Dark Castle[/spoiler]


Other Changes:

Updated the description of the item 'Treasure Map'


Bug Fixes:

The items 'Fire Essence', 'Water Essence', and 'Wind Essence' are now properly removed from your inventory when [spoiler]presented at the Lost Shrine[/spoiler]. For old save files, these items will be removed when interacting with the Save Crystal in Dark Castle.
Morgan now learns the attack command [spoiler]'Change Weapon' upon acquiring the item 'Adventurer's Whip'[/spoiler]. For old save files, this attack command will be learned when interacting with the Save Crystal in Dark Castle.

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 27
notes.notes:
Text Changes:

Corrected a spelling error in the book "The Moon and the Silver Chariot"
Corrected a spelling error in the book "The Girl and the Dragon" 
Corrected a spelling error in Lars' letter to herself
